feeds.description: Greenlove Wellness provides a fresh take on lifestyle posts, promoting a plant-based healthy lifestyle with a holistic approach to health and wellness. Lucy's journey with cannabis during college inspired her to advocate for its calming benefits, fostering balance amidst life's hustle.
